set.body: Acceptance criteria: one real edf2asc or declaratively mapped CSV recording flows through accumulated import diagnostics, validated Recording, fitted SyncEvidence, visual-angle warp, lineage-preserving preprocessing, corrected event detection, static frame-bound AoiSet, dwell, first entry, run count, transitions, and tidy CSV or Arrow export. The result exposes excluded and unclassified time, sample origins, exact algorithm configuration, frame and clock specifications, input and operation provenance, warnings, and an explanation report. The fixture runs in CI and a reader can reproduce the result without understanding kernel internals.
set.title: Golden workflow: real tracker input to tidy AOI results
